_comment: M19 budgets, recorded at the first scale run (2026-11-15). Starting points from PLAN M19 and concepts Q1; kept unless a measurement says otherwise. Times in milliseconds. Each is judged by the 95th percentile (nearest rank) over the runs and its percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval; a budget passes when the percentile and the interval's upper bound are both within it. `runs` is the minimum number of runs a record must have (59 runs with none over budget support "fewer than 5% of runs exceed it" at 95% confidence, owner's ruling 2026-11-15); the nightly job sets PCS_SCALE_RUNS=59, and a shorter smoke run (PCS_SCALE_RUNS=3) deliberately fails check-evidence.

sync.full.what: first full sync of the scale scenario into an empty store

sync.noop.what: re-sync with no change at HotCRP; must also write zero rows

solve.full.what: full assignment solve from scratch (no pinned reviews) over every paper and TPMS affinity: build, flow, repair, audit, CSV

table.papers.render.what: open the Papers tab on 4,000 papers: load from the store and first rows on screen

table.reviews.render.what: open the Reviews tab on the scale reviews: load and first rows on screen

table.papers.filter.what: slowest keystroke while typing a filter into the Papers table

table.reviews.filter.what: slowest keystroke while typing a filter into the Reviews table
